column1: Campaign trigger rules move to new rule builder
column5:
Trigger rules now live in a new rule builder. The old "On survey complete" trigger is renamed "Response received" and existing rules are migrated automatically.

Linked documents: DOC-01 Building campaign triggers with the rule builder

column1: Default reminder interval changes from 3 to 5 days
column5:
New and existing campaigns without a custom setting will send reminders every 5 days instead of every 3 days.

Linked documents: DOC-02 Reminder settings for campaigns

Survey builder adds an NPS slider question with a 0-10 scale and mobile-friendly layout.

Linked documents: DOC-03 Adding an NPS slider question

column1: Review widget carousel layout; grid layout deprecated
column5:
A new carousel layout is available. The grid layout will be removed at the end of the quarter; sites using it must switch.

Linked documents: DOC-04 Switching review widgets from grid to carousel

PDF export from dashboards is removed. Exports are available as CSV only.

Linked documents: DOC-05 Exporting dashboards

Salesforce sync now runs every hour instead of every 15 minutes to reduce API limits.

Linked documents: DOC-06 Salesforce sync settings

Customers using SAML SSO must upload the new certificate before 15 January or logins will fail.

Linked documents: DOC-07 Rotating your SAML certificate
Escalation emails are no longer sent twice.
Large reports load up to 40% faster.

column1: Fix: scheduled campaigns use wrong time zone
column5: Scheduled campaigns now send in the account's time zone.

column5:
